Interface RouteCaptures

public sealed interface RouteCaptures
The values a RouteTemplate captured for its variables, in the order of the variables. The values are as they appear in the path, not percent-decoded.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • of

      static RouteCaptures of(String path, List<RouteTemplateVariable> variables, List<@Nullable String> values)
      Captures that take the lists as they are, without copying them: for a template that matches many requests. The caller hands them over: they must not change afterwards. Pass the list of RouteTemplate.variables() itself, the same instance, which the router then recognizes without comparing it.
      Parameters:
      path - The path that was matched
      variables - The variables, in order: an immutable list
      values - The values, one per variable, not percent-decoded: a list that does not change
      Returns:
      The captures
